traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.text: Choose a kind of dragon; it sets the damage type of your breath weapon and your resistance.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.text: In place of one attack, exhale a 15-foot cone or 30-foot line: Dexterity save (DC 8 + Constitution modifier + proficiency bonus) or take 1d10 damage, half on a success. Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.text: You resist the damage type of your ancestry.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright, and in darkness as if it were dim.

traits.name: Draconic Flight
traits.text: From level 5, as a bonus action you sprout spectral wings for 10 minutes and gain a fly speed equal to your speed, once per long rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: You see in dim light and darkness out to 120 feet.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.text: You resist poison damage and have advantage on saves against the Poisoned condition.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.text: Your hit point maximum rises by 1, and by 1 more each time you gain a level.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.text: As a bonus action on stone, gain Tremorsense 60 feet for 10 minutes. Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright, and in darkness as if it were dim.

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.text: Choose Drow, High Elf or Wood Elf; each gives a cantrip or speed bonus now and spells at levels 3 and 5.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.text: You have advantage on saves against the Charmed condition.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.text: You are proficient in Insight, Perception or Survival.

traits.name: Trance
traits.text: You do not sleep; four hours of meditation count as a long rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright, and in darkness as if it were dim.

traits.name: Gnomish Cunning
traits.text: You have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves.

traits.name: Gnomish Lineage
traits.text: Choose Forest Gnome (Minor Illusion, Speak with Animals) or Rock Gnome (Mending, Prestidigitation, tiny clockwork devices).

traits.name: Giant Ancestry
traits.text: Choose a gift from a kind of giant, such as Stone's Endurance (reduce damage by 1d12 + Constitution modifier as a reaction). Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.

traits.name: Large Form
traits.text: From level 5, as a bonus action become Large for 10 minutes, with advantage on Strength checks and +10 feet of speed, once per long rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.text: You have advantage on checks to end the Grappled condition and count as one size larger for carrying.

traits.name: Brave
traits.text: You have advantage on saves against the Frightened condition.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.text: You can move through the space of any creature larger than you.

traits.name: Luck
traits.text: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a d20 test, you can reroll it and must use the new roll.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.text: You can hide when only a creature at least one size larger than you blocks the view.

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.text: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.text: You are proficient in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.text: You gain an Origin feat of your choice.

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.text: Dash as a bonus action and gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus. Uses equal your proficiency bonus per short or long rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: You see in dim light and darkness out to 120 feet.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.text: When you drop to 0 hit points but are not killed, you can drop to 1 instead, once per long rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright, and in darkness as if it were dim.

traits.name: Fiendish Legacy
traits.text: Choose Abyssal, Chthonic or Infernal; each gives a damage resistance and a cantrip now, and spells at levels 3 and 5.

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.text: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip.

alert.name: Alert
alert.text: Add your proficiency bonus to initiative, and you may swap initiative with a willing ally right after rolling.

magic-initiate-cleric.name: Magic Initiate (Cleric)
magic-initiate-cleric.text: You know two Cleric cantrips and one level 1 Cleric spell, which you can cast once per long rest without a slot. Choose Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma for them.

magic-initiate-wizard.name: Magic Initiate (Wizard)
magic-initiate-wizard.text: You know two Wizard cantrips and one level 1 Wizard spell, which you can cast once per long rest without a slot. Choose Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma for them.

savage-attacker.name: Savage Attacker
savage-attacker.text: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, roll its damage dice twice and use either roll.

skilled.name: Skilled
skilled.text: You gain proficiency in any three skills or tools.
